name: Closed-form Tracking
aliases: Inverse Transform Sampling for Free Paths
definition: A method for sampling free paths in simple volumes (constant, polynomial, or exponentially varying extinction) using inverse transform sampling.
summary: Closed-form Tracking is a Monte Carlo technique that samples free-flight distances in participating media by analytically inverting the transmittance function, distinguishing itself from global volume sampling through its reliance on local optical depth invertibility.
